card.name: Comma ending an If-condition clause
card.fires_on: The comma that closes an opening 'If ... occurs/is suspected/are present' clause in warnings, right before the instruction on what to do. Also seen on a period inside a section cross-reference number.

modes.label: Comma after If-clause
modes.description: Comma after a conditional clause such as 'If serotonin syndrome occurs' or 'If adrenal insufficiency is suspected', just before the action clause.
modes.example: If serotonin syndrome occurs<<,>> consider discontinuation of fluoxetine and/or

modes.label: Period in section reference
modes.description: Decimal point inside a numbered cross-reference in parentheses after a dosing instruction.
modes.example: Stop treatment or reduce dose frequency ( 2<<.>>1 , 5.3 ).

card.writes: It seems to prepare the model for the start of an instruction clause, which is not clearly shown by the promoted or suppressed tokens.
card.plain: It fires at the comma after an 'If this happens' warning, just before the text says what to do.
